split_note: California’s base rate is 1% (Proposition 13); the rest is voter-approved debt, shown as debt.
rollback_note: California has no yearly no-raise rate: Proposition 13 caps the base rate at 1% and limits assessed value growth to 2% a year until a home sells.
limits: Parcel taxes and special assessments on the same bill aren’t rates and aren’t included.
